resources.string: Use compatible hardware video output with a separate subtitle layer. Pixel filters and shaders use GPU output.
Try a declared P5 Dolby hardware decoder even without a Dolby display. The system may map to HDR10 or SDR; this does not enable Dolby Vision on your TV.
Request the video frame rate from Android. Your TV may briefly go black when switching.
For a confirmed HDR10 TV when box firmware omits HDMI HDR capabilities. Requests PQ output; an SDR display may show incorrect colors.
On a display without Dolby Vision, play compatible P7 video as HDR10. Preserves base resolution; omits enhancement layer and Dolby dynamic metadata.
Downmix to stereo for boxes with multichannel audio underruns. Disables surround output.
